submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 2 is the north native strip matching the top 230 pixels. Image 3 is the west native strip matching the left 230 pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Top roughly one-third is pale golden sand. Preserve the existing large rounded grey coastal boulder entering from left/bottom: its warm-lit upper face and darker lower side fill the lower-left, with a smaller connected lobe toward x=700,y=1000. White shallow surf surrounds the right side of this same rock and enters from around x=550,y=520 down to bottom near x=600. Light turquoise shallows stay on the right; do not add another rock, change the rock footprint, or extend dry sand into the surf. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. No added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
